# Technical Deep Dive (slide-based)

[← OpenAI](../README.md) · [Every OpenAI question](../../openai.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/technical-deep-dive)

`deep-dive` `presentation` `project-deep-dive`

---

## Observations
- One applicant ended the round feeling that the interviewer viewed their project experience as too shallow, and that impression aligned with the eventual rejection.
- A classic deep-dive failure involved covering too much material, running out of time, and being asked, “Why use hashing for embeddings in your search system rather than BERT?” The candidate privately wondered, “How would you embed an item ID with BERT?” — **the failed deep dive ended the entire interview loop**.
- The deep dive and HM behavioral interview become available only after the technical rounds are passed, so reaching them is already meaningful evidence.
- Interviewers encounter plenty of impressive projects, so the standard is demanding.

## Preparation
- Keep the slides focused, and explore one or two of your strongest projects in depth.
- Prepare for questions such as “Why not X?” and “What happens when this must scale by 10x?”
- Use a progression of motivation → technical tradeoffs → metric gains → lessons learned.
- Do not pretend to have expertise in subjects you do not truly own.
